mapper.select: insert into pms_task_chg_req (comp_cd, proj_id, task_id, requester_id, before_start, before_end, new_start, new_end, reason, task_row_ver, status, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{projId}, #{taskId}, #{requesterId}, #{beforeStart}, #{beforeEnd}, #{newStart}, #{newEnd}, #{reason}, #{taskRowVer}, #{status}, #{by}, #{by}) returning req_id
mapper.update: update pms_task_chg_req set apr_id = #{aprId} where req_id = #{id} and status = 'IN_APPROVAL' and apr_id is null
mapper.sql: r.req_id, r.proj_id, r.task_id, t.task_nm, r.requester_id, u.user_nm as requester_nm, r.before_start, r.before_end, r.new_start, r.new_end, r.reason, r.task_row_ver, r.status, r.apr_id, a.status as apr_status, a.requester_id as apr_requester_id, r.decided_at, r.decided_by, r.decide_note, r.row_ver, r.created_at
from pms_task_chg_req r join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.requester_id left join pms_task t on t.task_id = r.task_id left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = r.apr_id
mapper.select: select status from pms_task_chg_req where req_id = #{id} for update

select
where r.task_id = #{taskId} and r.status in ('REQUESTED', 'IN_APPROVAL')
mapper.sql: from pms_task_chg_req r join pms_project p on p.proj_id = r.proj_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.requester_id left join pms_task t on t.task_id = r.task_id where p.pm_user_id = #{userId} and p.status in ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD') and r.status = 'REQUESTED' and r.requester_id <> #{userId}
mapper.update: update pms_task_chg_req set status = #{status}, decided_at = now(), decided_by = #{by}, decide_note = #{note}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where req_id = #{id} and status in ('REQUESTED', 'IN_APPROVAL')
